title: Scalar realization over an arbitrary fixed coefficient calculus
statement: Fix a prime l, finite extensions E,L of Q_l, an embedding iota:E to L, a scheme W, a coefficient derived-system calculus SW and a normalized L Roos model rhoW [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]. There exists an IntegralComparisonScalarModel for this fixed calculus and Roos model, with the whole-system coherent-presentation normalization, without any residue-characteristic invertibility hypothesis.

source.place: Tags 03EK, 03D7, 06YY, 07A4 and 0941; quotient adjunctions, tensor generators and derived limits.

proof.text: Obtain ordinary and derived quotient models compatible with the fixed calculus. Evaluated ordinary quotients of good complexes are K-flat; the componentwise tensor criterion gives K-flatness on the sequence site.

Combine the scalar cochain counit, the Roos bridge, and the strict scalar tower comparison. Descend their natural isomorphism through the good-complex localization. Transport to any coherent presentation by the unique strict quotient isomorphism; counit naturality cancels its inverse and gives normalization.
